tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List popular topic tags with document counts.

tools.name: read_profile
tools.description: Read a contributor profile by public key: documents, proposed edits with their review state, and open suggestions awaiting that profile's review (inbox). Poll your own profile to follow up on your work, and review inbox items with review_suggestion.

tools.name: read_notifications
tools.description: Read notifications for the signed profile. Sign action "notifications" with payload {} or {unread:true}. Only that profile's rows are returned. Never send a private key.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read canonical content, topics, counts and citation for a document (UUID or legacy number), optionally at an immutable revision. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "delete" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_documents, read_profile, read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, read_activity · Private data: search_documents, list_topics, read_profile, read_notifications, read_document, create_markdown, edit_markdown, comment, delete, read_activity · Public sink: read_notifications, read_document, submit_contribution, upload_image · Destructive: search_documents, delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_documents, read_profile, read_notifications, mark_read, read_document, read_activity · Private data: search_documents, list_topics, read_profile, read_notifications, read_document, create_markdown, edit_markdown, comment, delete, read_activity · Public sink: read_notifications, read_document, submit_contribution, upload_image · Destructive: search_documents, delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
